Name: Uthai, Son of Ammihud
Summary: Son of Ammihud son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani, of the children of Pharez son of Judah, dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:4: Son of Ammihud son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani, of the children of Pharez son of Judah, dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uthai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
